items.cn: 先识别题目动词，再决定答案需要写数值、步骤、证据还是完整解释。
items.example: Plot a graph of V against I.
items.translation: 作 V 关于 I 的图像。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: add names symbols or values to a diagram
items.cn: 先识别题目动词，再决定答案需要写数值、步骤、证据还是完整解释。
items.example: Label the forces acting on the object.
items.translation: 标出物体所受的力。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: add the missing information to a diagram table or equation
items.cn: 先识别题目动词，再决定答案需要写数值、步骤、证据还是完整解释。
items.example: Complete the ray diagram.
items.translation: 补全光路图。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: judge using evidence or calculate a numerical value as context requires
items.cn: 先识别题目动词，再决定答案需要写数值、步骤、证据还是完整解释。
items.example: Evaluate the effectiveness of the method.
items.translation: 评价该方法的有效性。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: use a logically complete argument to establish a statement
items.cn: 先识别题目动词，再决定答案需要写数值、步骤、证据还是完整解释。
items.example: Prove that the function is increasing.
items.translation: 证明该函数为增函数。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: translate a mathematical or graphical result into its contextual meaning
items.cn: 先识别题目动词，再决定答案需要写数值、步骤、证据还是完整解释。
items.example: Interpret the gradient of the graph.
items.translation: 解释图像斜率的实际含义。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: Do not estimate lengths or angles directly from the diagram.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: The diagram is not drawn to scale.
items.translation: 该图未按比例绘制。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: Use the ideal projectile or free-fall model unless told otherwise.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Assume air resistance is negligible.
items.translation: 假设空气阻力可以忽略。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: give your answer to three significant figures
items.meaning: 答案保留三位有效数字
items.definition: Round only the final result unless intermediate rounding is unavoidable.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Give your answer to three significant figures.
items.translation: 答案保留三位有效数字。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: give your answer in standard form
items.meaning: 用科学记数法表示答案
items.definition: Write the result as a number from 1 to 10 multiplied by a power of ten.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Give your answer in standard form.
items.translation: 用科学记数法写出答案。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: A correct numerical value may lose marks if its unit is missing or incompatible.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Include an appropriate unit in your answer.
items.translation: 在答案中写出合适的单位。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: use the data in the table
items.definition: Select values from the supplied table rather than inventing or recalling them.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Use the data in the table to calculate the resistance.
items.translation: 使用表格中的数据计算电阻。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: Read or calculate the required quantity from graph features such as gradient or area.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Use the graph to determine the acceleration.
items.translation: 利用图像求出加速度。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: Add a tangent best-fit line or construction line needed for the calculation.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: By drawing a suitable line, estimate the initial gradient.
items.translation: 通过画一条合适的直线，估算初始斜率。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: Method marks depend on visible equations substitutions and reasoning.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Show all your working clearly.
items.translation: 清楚写出完整计算过程。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: you may use the formula booklet
items.definition: Choose and adapt a supplied formula rather than assuming it will be quoted in the question.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: You may use the formula booklet.
items.translation: 你可以使用公式册。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: Keep exact values and use algebraic or known-angle methods.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Solve the equation without using a calculator.
items.translation: 在不使用计算器的情况下解方程。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: leave your answer in exact form
items.definition: Keep surds fractions pi or logarithms rather than decimal approximations.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Leave your answer in exact form.
items.translation: 答案保留为精确形式。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: for all real values of x
items.definition: The statement must hold throughout the real domain, not only for selected examples.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Prove the identity for all real values of x.
items.translation: 证明该恒等式对所有实数 x 成立。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: for which the expression is defined
items.meaning: 在表达式有定义的范围内
items.definition: Exclude values that make denominators zero or violate roots and logarithms.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Solve for all x for which the expression is defined.
items.translation: 求表达式有定义范围内的所有 x。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: Use initial velocity u equals zero.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: The particle starts from rest at A.
items.translation: 质点从 A 点由静止开始运动。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: The constant-acceleration equations are available.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: The car moves with constant acceleration.
items.translation: 汽车做匀加速运动。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: Ignore the object's dimensions and rotational effects.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: The package is modelled as a particle.
items.translation: 将包裹建模为质点。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: the string is light and inextensible
items.definition: Tension is uniform and connected particles share constrained motion.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: The string is light and inextensible.
items.translation: 绳子质量可忽略且不可伸长。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: Ignore friction between the string and pulley.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: The pulley is smooth.
items.translation: 滑轮光滑，忽略摩擦。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: Include a friction force whose direction opposes motion or impending motion.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: The particle moves up a rough plane.
items.translation: 质点沿粗糙斜面向上运动。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: Static friction has reached its limiting value.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: The block is on the point of slipping.
items.translation: 物块处于即将滑动的临界状态。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: find the range of possible values
items.definition: Use inequalities and include or exclude endpoints carefully.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Find the range of possible values of k.
items.translation: 求 k 的可能取值范围。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: find the coordinates of the stationary points
items.definition: Set the first derivative to zero and substitute back into the function.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Find the coordinates of the stationary points.
items.translation: 求所有驻点的坐标。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: determine the nature of each stationary point
items.definition: Use sign changes or the second derivative to classify maximum minimum or inflection.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Determine the nature of each stationary point.
items.translation: 判断每个驻点的类型。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: the curve has exactly two distinct roots
items.meaning: 曲线恰有两个不同的根
items.definition: Translate the condition into a discriminant or intersection requirement.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Find k such that the equation has exactly two distinct roots.
items.translation: 求使方程恰有两个不同实根的 k。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: Use product probabilities and test whether conditioning changes probability.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Given that A and B are independent, find P of A intersection B.
items.translation: 已知 A 与 B 独立，求 A 与 B 同时发生的概率。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: This often signals conditional probability or a restricted sample space.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Find the probability that X is greater than 3, given that X is even.
items.translation: 已知 X 为偶数，求 X 大于 3 的概率。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: at the five percent significance level
items.definition: Compare the p-value or critical region with 0.05.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Test the claim at the five percent significance level.
items.translation: 在 5% 显著性水平下检验该说法。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: there is insufficient evidence to conclude
items.meaning: 没有足够证据得出结论
items.definition: Do not say the null hypothesis is proved; state the contextual conclusion carefully.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: There is insufficient evidence to conclude that the mean has increased.
items.translation: 没有足够证据认为均值已经增加。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: The observed result falls in the critical region or has a sufficiently small p-value.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: The result is statistically significant at the chosen level.
items.translation: 该结果在所选显著性水平下具有统计显著性。

items.subject: exam-language
items.meaning: 在实验不确定度范围内
items.definition: Differences smaller than combined uncertainty may not be meaningful.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: The values agree within experimental uncertainty.
items.translation: 这些数值在实验不确定度范围内一致。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: Use the stated reference or accepted value in the denominator.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Calculate the percentage difference between the two values.
items.translation: 计算这两个数值之间的百分比差。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: Use steepest and shallowest acceptable lines when required.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Estimate the uncertainty in the gradient.
items.translation: 估算斜率的不确定度。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: the line of best fit does not pass through the origin
items.meaning: 最佳拟合线不经过原点
items.definition: A non-zero intercept may indicate systematic error or a missing constant term.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: The line of best fit does not pass through the origin.
items.translation: 最佳拟合线没有通过原点。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: Exclude only clearly identified anomalies and do not cherry-pick ordinary scatter.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Ignore any anomalous results when drawing the line.
items.translation: 画线时忽略异常结果。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: suggest one improvement to the method
items.definition: Name a specific change and explain how it reduces a stated limitation.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Suggest one improvement to the experimental method.
items.translation: 提出一种改进实验方法的措施。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: identify the main source of uncertainty
items.meaning: 指出主要不确定度来源
items.definition: Compare instrument resolution and measurement method rather than listing every possible error.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Identify the main source of uncertainty in the experiment.
items.translation: 指出实验中最主要的不确定度来源。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: explain why the relationship is linear
items.meaning: 解释为什么关系是线性的
items.definition: Connect the equation to the plotted variables and constant gradient.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Explain why a graph of V against I is linear.
items.translation: 解释为什么 V 关于 I 的图像是直线。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: Write the physical or mathematical quantity including its unit.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: State the quantity represented by the gradient.
items.translation: 写出该斜率所表示的物理量。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: the area under the graph represents
items.definition: Use axis units to identify the accumulated quantity.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: State what the area under the velocity-time graph represents.
items.translation: 写出速度—时间图像下方面积所表示的物理量。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: initially increases at a decreasing rate
items.definition: The quantity rises while its gradient remains positive but becomes smaller.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: The displacement initially increases at a decreasing rate.
items.translation: 位移起初增加，但增加的速率逐渐减小。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: The graph levels off toward a horizontal asymptote.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: The current approaches a constant value.
items.translation: 电流逐渐趋近于一个恒定值。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: A graph through the origin is straight when the stated variables are used.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: The extension is directly proportional to the force.
items.translation: 伸长量与力成正比。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: The product of the two quantities is constant.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: The pressure is inversely proportional to the volume.
items.translation: 压强与体积成反比。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: is proportional to the square of
items.definition: Doubling the input multiplies the output by four.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: The kinetic energy is proportional to the square of the speed.
items.translation: 动能与速率的平方成正比。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: Treat the relevant mechanical or electrical energy transfer as ideal.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Neglect energy losses to the surroundings.
items.translation: 忽略向周围环境的能量损失。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: Set total energy before equal to total energy after while tracking transfers.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Use the fact that conservation of energy applies.
items.translation: 利用能量守恒这一条件。

items.subject: exam-language
items.definition: No external resultant force or relevant exchange acts on the system.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Assume the collision system is isolated.
items.translation: 假设碰撞系统是孤立的。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: comment on whether the value is reasonable
items.definition: Compare magnitude unit sign and physical limits with real expectations.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Comment on whether your calculated value is reasonable.
items.translation: 评价你计算出的数值是否合理。

items.subject: exam-language
items.word: use your answer to the previous part
items.definition: Carry forward the previous result even if it may be numerically imperfect.
items.cn: A-Level 数学/物理题干理解：先翻译限制条件，再把它转换成方程、模型或答题要求。
items.example: Use your answer to the previous part to calculate the power.
items.translation: 使用上一问的答案计算功率。
